newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Dec S&P 500 hits fresh high, ends up sharply.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Dec S&P 500 hits fresh high, ends up sharply.

text.p: Sept 13 - U.S. December S&P 500s hit a fresh session peak late at 689.00 and closed at a more than 10-week high. Early data sparked the move, technicals extended it as broad-based buying in good volume fueled S&P futures most of the day. Late buyers led first by locals covering intraday shorts, then Wall Street firms piled on, traders said. Contract high looms at 695.00. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
